record.context_brief: Bounded packing in virtually polycyclic groups
record.original_question: Does every subgroup of a virtually polycyclic group have bounded packing, meaning that for every radius r > 0 there exists N such that any collection of N distinct left cosets contains two cosets whose distance is at least r with respect to a proper left-invariant metric on the ambient group?

evidence.quote: We say that H has bounded packing in G, if given any r > 0 we can find a number N, which may depend on G, H, and r, such that any collection of N distinct left cosets of H in G {g1H, ..., gN H} contains a pair giH, gjH which is separated by distance at least r, or d(giH, gjH) >= r.

In light of Theorem 3.2.7 one can ask the question whether every subgroup of a solvable group has bounded packing. While an affirmative answer to this question is unlikely, one has the following conjecture promoted in [14], which has recently been settled, see [33] and [28]: Conjecture Every subgroup of a virtually polycyclic group P has the bounded packing property.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a virtually polycyclic group, i.e., a group that contains a polycyclic subgroup of finite index (recall that a group is polycyclic if it admits a finite subnormal series with cyclic factors). Equip $G$ with a proper left-invariant metric $d$ (any two such metrics on a finitely generated group are quasi-isometric, and properness means that balls are finite). For a subgroup $H \le G$ and two left cosets $aH, bH$, define their distance by $d(aH, bH) = \inf\{d(x,y) : x \in aH,\ y \in bH\}$.

A subgroup $H \le G$ is said to have bounded packing in $G$ if for every $r > 0$ there exists a positive integer $N = N(G,H,r)$ such that for any collection $g_1 H, g_2 H, \ldots, g_N H$ of $N$ distinct left cosets of $H$ in $G$, there exist indices $i \ne j$ with $d(g_i H, g_j H) \ge r$.

Prove or disprove: every subgroup $H$ of every virtually polycyclic group $G$ has bounded packing in $G$.
artifact.status_search_result: The Hruska–Wise conjecture that every subgroup of a virtually polycyclic group has bounded packing has been established affirmatively in recent work. Partial results (e.g., for polycyclic groups of Hirsch length ≤ 3, and for nilpotent-by-polycyclic groups) appeared earlier, and the full conjecture is reported as settled. Related counterexamples are known for general solvable groups (derived length 3), showing the result does not extend beyond the polycyclic setting.

status_evidence.title: On Bounded Packing in Polycyclic Groups
status_evidence.snippet: Bounded packing established for subgroups in polycyclic groups under hypotheses including low Hirsch length.
status_evidence.claim: Partial cases of the conjecture were proved for polycyclic groups.

status_evidence.title: Decomposing groups by codimension-1 subgroups
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses bounded packing for subgroups of polycyclic and related groups.
status_evidence.claim: Provides further progress and references on bounded packing in polycyclic groups.
